units.rawText: Professor, welcome to the <color=orange>Abax Gallery</color>. Thanks to the hard work of the Technical and Engineering Departments, we've finally managed to complete the combat simulation system that you and Instructor Python proposed.

units.rawText: I'm kind of surprised by how polished it is. Was the area we're standing in generated by this system as well?

units.rawText: The Abax Gallery analyzes this data and then puts it together. This allows Dolls training in it to experience different environments and regions and face a variety of enemies, which ought to help improve the Dolls' fighting power and their adaptability.

units.rawText: We can use enemy data to simulate battles against them. But how can you simulate the randomness of regional exploration within a confined space?

units.rawText: That would be thanks to the core function of the Abax Gallery. Once the Dolls finish exploring the current zone, it will <color=orange>randomly generate three new exploration zones for everyone to choose from</color>.
